queries.name: GetServiceRequest
queries.output: immutable identity, official/local business IDs, revision, current accepted source projection when available, linked root RFC count, Device Reference count, warnings
rules: business-ID lookup resolves one surviving SR
historical/terminal presentation never creates another entity

queries.name: GetRfc
queries.output: immutable identity, canonical RFC No., current Customer or unresolved, derived hierarchy role, local archive state, current accepted source projection, counts/warnings
queries.rule: master/subordinate/standalone role is derived from active rfc_hierarchy_edges

queries.name: GetRfcBranch
queries.output: root plus keyset-paginated direct subordinate rows with immutable IDs, RFC Nos., resolved/unresolved Customer state, archive/source status summaries
rules: no recursive traversal beyond one child level
known branch Customer mismatch is invariant failure, unresolved member is explicit warning

queries.name: GetServiceRequestRfcBranches
queries.output: active direct root RFC links plus each root's current subordinate branch; inherited relation provenance identifies direct root link
rules: no subordinate direct link is synthesized
WFM/Task data joined through owning LLD interfaces, not copied into SR relationship rows

queries.name: GetEffectiveServiceRequestContextForRfc
queries.output: for a root, its direct active SR relationships; for a subordinate, its parent root's direct active SR relationships plus inherited_via_root identity
queries.rule: inherited context is query-derived and never persisted as subordinate sr_rfc_links

queries.name: ListTicketDeviceReferences
queries.output: active Device Reference identities/current operational names plus optional registration projection supplied by LLD-08
rules: registration projection is optional derived metadata
query never substitutes network_element_id for device_reference_id

queries.name: GetRfcDeviceContextForBranch
queries.output: root Device References and separately grouped per-subordinate Device References
queries.rule: sets are not unioned into copied branch ownership; UI may display a derived union with source RFC provenance

queries.name: ListWorkingNotes
queries.output: keyset page ordered by created_at_utc, working_note_id
rules: current active note content only; audit/history surfaces provide prior edited/removed content
imports never participate in note mutation

queries.name: PreviewRfcHierarchyMutation
queries.output: current roles/branch/customer warnings, affected edge identities, direct-SR-link blockers, history-risk state
queries.rule: read-only advisory preview; command reruns authoritative checks inside UoW

queries.name: PreviewSrRfcLink
queries.output: resolved governing root, current duplicate state, subordinate-origin provenance, relationship/context impact summary
queries.rule: preview cannot merge entities/devices/tasks/notes and cannot authorize stale mutation

pagination: All unbounded collections use deterministic keyset cursors and field-specific page limits; no product business cap such as 20 RFC children is introduced.
